claim: When a health check fails and failover occurs, Route 53 disables the resource records for the failed endpoint and no longer serves them; this failover step causes traffic to be routed to the healthy endpoints instead.

qualifiers.condition: in the FAQ example, after the application fails three consecutive health checks

evidence.quote: Route 53 disables the resource records for the failed endpoint and no longer serves these records. This is the failover step, which causes traffic to begin being routed to your healthy endpoint(s) instead of your failed endpoint.
In this example, your application fails three consecutive health checks, triggering the following events.
